note: JS-only UTF-16/UTF-8 clamping vectors (source-map.ts doc comment; SRS §5.3). The Rust service only returns valid UTF-8 text, so a lone surrogate or an index inside a pair cannot arrive from IPC; these cases pin the front-end helper behavior used for DOM slicing. `direction` says which argument is the input: utf16-to-bytes -> utf16IndexToUtf8ByteOffset, bytes-to-utf16 -> utf8ByteOffsetToUtf16Index.
